title: Redis (Upstash) health
description: Fly-managed Upstash Redis (spinr-redis, yyz), scraped every 60s by Alloy's built-in Redis exporter as the restricted grafana_exporter ACL user (INFO/PING only, no key access) into the local VictoriaMetrics store (30-day history). Memory is deliberately not shown: Upstash reports used_memory as a few KB for ~100 keys, which isn't a real figure.

panels.description: Share of key lookups that found the key, over the selected time range. Misses are normal for a cache (a miss triggers a DB read), but a sudden drop means the cache stopped helping. Upstash answers INFO from two nodes (primary + replica) with separate counters, and each scrape lands on either one -- a plain rate() reads every switch as a counter reset (observed: 69k cmd/s naive vs ~0.2 cmd/s real). So each node's counter is followed separately (rolling 5m max = higher-count node, min = lower-count node), a minute's increment is only counted when both nodes were visible in the window before and after it, and the two are summed. Rates are 10-minute averages.
